groups.title: Commercial & Industrial HVAC
groups.summary: Packaged rooftops, split systems, chillers, boilers, make-up air and process cooling, installed and kept running by crews that do this every day.
groups.intro: A rooftop failure in a restaurant, a clinic or a plant is not a comfort issue, it is a revenue issue. Product spoils, tenants call, production stops. groups.title: Commercial Refrigeration
groups.summary: Walk-ins, reach-ins, prep tables, ice machines and rack systems for kitchens, grocery, convenience stores and cold storage.
groups.intro: A walk-in drifting out of range is a countdown on everything inside it, so refrigeration calls get triaged accordingly, including nights and weekends. Temperature swings, ice buildup on the coil, a compressor running longer than it should and rising power bills show up weeks before a hard failure. Regular maintenance is how you find them then instead of on a Saturday.

about.title: A Texas MEP contractor since 2013.
text: Accurate Air Solutions, LLC has been working in Texas since 2013. We are a mechanical, electrical and plumbing contractor built around commercial and industrial work — facilities, plants, restaurants, retail, clinics, and the general contractors building them.

What makes the difference on a job site is that we self-perform. HVAC, plumbing and electrical are all in house and all licensed. So is the sheet metal, fabricated in our own Abilene shop. That means one contractor is accountable for the scope, and your schedule is not hostage to somebody else's lead time.

Abilene is home base, and where the fabrication shop lives; that location runs commercial and industrial only. Lubbock and Dallas run residential, commercial and industrial. Work is permitted where permits are required and inspected where inspections apply, and if a general contractor or an insurer needs documentation, we have it.
about.imageAlt: An Accurate Air Solutions truck and a crane at a hospital dock, with new rooftop units on the trailer

faqs.q: Do you work on residential systems?
faqs.a: In Lubbock and Dallas, yes — residential, commercial and industrial. In Abilene we run commercial and industrial only; residential there is handled by our own brands, Hawkins Air Conditioning for HVAC and Double R Plumbing for plumbing.

faqs.q: Are you licensed for all three trades?
faqs.a: Yes. HVAC under TACLA53299C, electrical under TECL34064, and plumbing under Master Plumber license M18761 — all in house, not subcontracted.

faqs.q: Do you really fabricate your own ductwork?
faqs.a: We do, in our own shop in Abilene. Custom transitions, plenums, hoods and fittings built to field dimensions, which keeps duct off the critical path on a schedule.

faqs.q: How fast can you respond to an emergency?
faqs.a: We dispatch 24 hours a day. Response time depends on where you are and what is down, but you will talk to someone who can actually send a truck rather than take a message.
Yes. One agreement, one point of contact, and consistent reporting across Abilene, Lubbock and Dallas.

faqs.q: How long will the work take?
faqs.a: That depends on how many people we put on it. Because the crews are on our own payroll rather than a subcontractor's, crew size is a decision we make rather than one we wait on — so tell us the window you have and we will tell you what it takes to hit it.

faqs.q: What kind of work can be financed?
faqs.a: Equipment replacement and larger repairs: rooftop and split-system changeouts, water heaters, panel and service upgrades, and full system replacements. Financing is available at all three locations, and all terms, rates and approval decisions are the lender's and subject to credit approval.

faqs.q: Are you bonded, and what are your insurance limits?
faqs.a: Bonding capacity is in excess of $50 million, through Granite Re. On insurance, tell us the requirements on your project and we will meet them — certificates go out on request. Our experience modification rate is 0.82.
